import json, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile; repo = pathlib.Path.cwd();

def write_project(name, source):
    root = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f'fozzylang-{name}-'))
    (root / 'src').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (root / 'fozzy.toml').write_text(f'[package]\nname="{name}"\nversion="0.1.0"\n\n[[target.bin]]\nname="{name}"\npath="src/main.fzy"\n')
    (root / 'src/main.fzy').write_text(source)
    return root

def verify(root, expect):
    proc = subprocess.run(['cargo', 'run', '-q', '-p', 'fz', '--', 'verify', str(root), '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
    payload = json.loads(proc.stdout.strip())
    assert proc.returncode == expect, (proc.returncode, payload)
    return payload

borrow_fail = write_project('thread_borrow_fail', "async fn worker(v: &'a i32) -> &'a i32 {\n    return v\n}\nfn main() -> i32 {\n    return 0\n}\n")
mutable_fail = write_project('thread_mutable_fail', "async fn worker(v: &'a mut i32) -> i32 {\n    discard v\n    return 0\n}\nfn main() -> i32 {\n    return 0\n}\n")
borrow_pass = write_project('borrow_pass', "fn borrow(v: &'a i32) -> &'a i32 {\n    return v\n}\nfn main() -> i32 {\n    return 0\n}\n")

borrow_payload = verify(borrow_fail, 1)
mutable_payload = verify(mutable_fail, 1)
pass_payload = verify(borrow_pass, 0)

borrow_diag = next(item for item in borrow_payload['items'] if 'thread-capable boundary' in item['message'])
assert 'Send/Sync-safe handle' in (borrow_diag.get('help') or ''), borrow_diag
assert 'capability token parameters' not in (borrow_diag.get('help') or ''), borrow_diag

mutable_diag = next(item for item in mutable_payload['items'] if 'Send/Sync-safe wrapper before thread crossing' in item['message'])
assert 'wrap mutable references/pointers' in (mutable_diag.get('help') or ''), mutable_diag
assert 'capability token parameters' not in (mutable_diag.get('help') or ''), mutable_diag

assert pass_payload['errors'] == 0, pass_payload
assert not any('thread-capable boundary' in item['message'] for item in pass_payload['items']), pass_payload
print('compiler-verify-thread-boundary-ok')
